source.attribution: Données: INSEE (Sirene, Licence Ouverte 2.0) + INPI (RNE), via Annuaire des Entreprises / DINUM.

access.note: No key. Documented limit ~7 req/s per IP. Not a bulk dump path — for the full population use Sirene/INPI bulk.

pagination.note: Max per_page=25; deep pagination capped (~page 1000). For lookups/enrichment by query or by SIREN, not full-population dumping.

parsing.notes: siren/siret stay strings. finances is an object keyed by year string -> {ca, resultat_net} (EUR integers, nullable). dirigeants[] is PII. Resolve nature_juridique / tranche_effectif via INSEE label tables; keep NAF Rev2 + NAF2025.

fixture_requirements: large company WITH a finances block (ca + resultat_net)
company with multiple dirigeants incl. a personne morale

live_test_plan.smoke: GET /search?q=la poste&per_page=3; assert results[0].siren and a finances year with ca+resultat_net.
live_test_plan.full: Use for enrichment/lookup by SIREN over the Sirene spine; throttle to ~7 req/s; persist raw JSON; do not attempt whole-population dumping (use Sirene/INPI bulk).

blockers: Aggregator/lookup API, not a bulk source — pair with Sirene/INPI bulk for full coverage.
finances limited to ca + resultat_net and to non-confidential filings.
